query: select jsonb_build_object('checked_at',clock_timestamp(),'project','hlvujbrmfdlrfxdjwsmb','catalogue',(select jsonb_object_agg(rel,stats) from (select 'authors' rel,jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'digest',md5(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(t)::text,'|' order by id),''))) stats from public.authors t union all select 'works',jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'digest',md5(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(t)::text,'|' order by id),''))) from public.works t union all select 'editions',jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'digest',md5(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(t)::text,'|' order by id),''))) from public.editions t union all select 'descriptions',jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'digest',md5(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(t)::text,'|' order by work_id,language),''))) from public.catalog_work_descriptions t union all select 'metadata',jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'digest',md5(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(t)::text,'|' order by edition_id),''))) from public.catalog_edition_metadata t) s),'ratings',(select jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'digest',md5(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(t)::text,'|' order by to_jsonb(t)::text),''))) from public.ratings t),'status',(select jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'digest',md5(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(t)::text,'|' order by to_jsonb(t)::text),''))) from public.user_book_status t),'accounts',(select jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'identity_updated_digest',md5(coalesce(string_agg(id::text||coalesce(updated_at::text,''),'|' order by id),''))) from auth.users),'reserved',(select jsonb_build_object('works',(select count(*) from public.works where id between 998100001 and 998100999),'editions',(select count(*) from public.editions where id between 998200001 and 998201999),'authors',(select count(*) from public.authors where id between 998300001 and 998300999)))) as preservation;
